newsitem.title: UK: UK govt to block Eurotunnel freight trains - report.
newsitem.headline: UK govt to block Eurotunnel freight trains - report.

text.p: Britain's Deputy Prime Minister John Prescott is poised to block the reopening of freight services through the Channel Tunnel, the Times Newspaper reported on Monday.

Prescott, who heads Britain's environment and transport ministry, will meet Eurotunnel executives this week but will stall plans to allow freight trains through the tunnel until he receives concrete assurances about safety improvements, the paper said.

No cargo trains have travelled through the tunnel since a fire last November caused 200 million pounds ($328 million) of damage. A French judicial inquiry is expected to rule the blaze was caused by arson, sources close to the case told Reuters.

The Times said Prescott told British officials involved in Anglo-French talks last week not to approve a resumption of freight services until assurances are received that a 20 million stg safety programme will be quickly introduced.
He also described a report from the Channel Tunnel Safety Authority on the fire as "an indictment of poor operating procedures and practices by Eurotunnel." ($1=.6098 Pound)
